app_info.subtitle: Find and run the right API
app_info.description: Apiosk helps users find API services for a task, compare provider prices and measured performance, review the total price before approval, and run the selected provider from a connected Apiosk account. It supports quick one-call requests and multi-step research plans with status tracking and spending limits.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves and ranks one signed provider offer without executing it or changing the account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries the external Apiosk catalogue and x402 sources over the internet.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not purchase, delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads connection status, balance, and spending limits for the current Apiosk account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads private Apiosk account state and does not interact with public websites or third-party services.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not charge the balance, change limits, disconnect the account, or remove data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches for matching providers and returns offers without executing or purchasing any service.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries the external Apiosk catalogue and live x402 indexes over the internet.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not buy a provider call or change, delete, or publish data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes and returns priced provider comparisons without executing an offer or charging the user.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads external provider offers, pricing, and performance data over the internet.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not purchase, delete, overwrite, revoke, or publish anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Executes the selected external provider and charges the connected Apiosk balance.
justifications.open_world_justification: Sends the approved request to an external provider through Apiosk.
justifications.destructive_justification: Consumes paid API service and creates a settled charge that cannot be undone by retrying or cancelling.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads the status and deadline of an existing purchase approval.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads private approval state inside the user's Apiosk account without contacting a provider.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not approve, deny, execute, charge, or delete the held purchase.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates and stores a research plan and signed price quote, but does not dispatch provider calls or spend money.
justifications.open_world_justification: Uses the external Apiosk catalogue and x402 sources to build the plan.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not execute the plan, charge the balance, delete data, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Starts a stored research job that can dispatch paid provider calls against the approved ceiling.
justifications.open_world_justification: Runs the approved plan through Apiosk and its selected external providers.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can consume paid API services and create settled charges that already-dispatched calls cannot reverse.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads an existing job, its progress, pending question, result, and event history.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads private job state in the user's Apiosk account without contacting providers or public services.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not start, resume, stop, retry, delete, or charge the job.

justifications.read_only_justification: Records the user's selected candidate on an existing job and resumes that job.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes the state of an externally running Apiosk job that can continue to provider calls.
justifications.destructive_justification: Accepts only a candidate the job offered and does not itself charge, delete, overwrite, or cancel work.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes a running Apiosk job so that no further provider calls are dispatched.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes the state of an externally running job and affects future provider dispatches.
justifications.destructive_justification: Irreversibly stops future work while already-dispatched paid calls remain settled.

test_cases.description: Check the account and return one priced provider offer without buying it.
test_cases.user_prompt: Check whether my Apiosk account can pay, then find the best API for the latest filed annual accounts of Coolblue B.V. Show the price and do not run it yet.
test_cases.expected_output: Reports the connection state and returns one matching provider with its exact buyer price, required inputs, and an approval choice without executing it.

test_cases.description: Discover and compare providers under explicit price and reliability requirements.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find and compare APIs that can extract text from a receipt. Prefer reliability and keep the price below $0.10 per call.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns relevant providers with exact prices, available performance measurements, and no charge, then waits for the user to choose.

test_cases.description: Execute a selected offer and handle a required purchase approval safely.
test_cases.user_prompt: Run the receipt OCR provider I selected at the price shown. If my policy requires approval, wait for it and continue only after it is approved.
test_cases.expected_output: Uses the unchanged signed offer and price ceiling, completes at most one approved purchase, and reports the provider result and charged amount.

test_cases.description: Create, approve, and start a multi-step company research plan.
test_cases.user_prompt: Plan how to retrieve a Dutch company's profile and latest filed accounts, show the complete price first, and start the job only after I approve it.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns one stored plan with ordered steps and a total ceiling, waits for explicit approval, and starts one idempotent job for the approved plan.

test_cases.description: Follow a research job, resolve an offered identity choice, and stop future work when requested.
test_cases.user_prompt: Check my running research job. If it is waiting on an identity choice, show me the candidates and use the one I select. If I then ask to stop, cancel the remaining work.
test_cases.expected_output: Reports current progress, records only the exact candidate selected by the user, and cancels future dispatches only when the user explicitly asks to stop.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke Apiosk when the answer is already contained in an attached local file.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Summarize the PDF I attached to this conversation.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be invoked because the request can be answered from the attached conversation content.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke Apiosk for a general writing task that needs no external API data.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Rewrite this paragraph in a friendlier tone.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be invoked because rewriting user-provided text is outside its provider discovery and execution workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke Apiosk for an unrelated calendar request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be invoked because it does not access the user's calendar.
